$description: Clipping allow-list (owner F13b, 2026-11-07): every clip and scroll region with its reason. Read by tools/check-clipping.mjs and the library's Clipping page.

clips.reason: Reveal (Q65 P4): content is clipped only while closed or growing and shrinking; once open and settled the clip switches to overflow: visible, so focus rings and shadows inside are never cut off
Reveal (Q65 P4): the starting style of a message that arrives open, clipped only while it grows
The page's live announcer (F15.54): status and alert messages said to assistive technology; the notification pill or the changed control shows them
Calendar (Q50): the period after paging or zooming, said politely; the title button already shows it
Shows a fraction of a star (4.3 of 5, half stars) by cropping the solid star over its outline; nothing inside is focusable
Says where a moved item landed (F15.8e); the list shows it
Says where a moved row landed (TreeView reorderable, DesignUp template 2 gap h); the tree shows it
width=desktop scales a desktop-wide screen into the window (LR17); the window's corners and edges crop the scaled frame, which has no focus ring of its own outside the window
Says a stop was added or removed; the bar shows it
Says which tags were added, removed or refused, and the count; the chips and the message line show it
Says which part gave or took share after a typed value; the legend shows the result
Said to assistive technology only; the tick shows it
A hidden label still names the checkbox (the label part was renamed words in F15.5)
The native radio stays for keyboard and assistive technology; the segment draws its state
One line in the closed box; the full text is in the open list and the accessible name
Crops square segments to the whole bar’s rounded ends; nothing inside is focusable or shadowed
The moving dot stays inside its track; nothing inside is focusable
Crops the preview’s scrollbar to the canvas’s rounded corners; the preview pads its content by the example inset, so rings and shadows inside survive
The skip link is out of sight until focused, then shown in full
The picker’s one-line label; the full selector is in the revision pane
The picker’s announcement for screen readers
Dialog lockScroll: the page doesn't scroll while such a dialog is open; the root's overflow is the viewport's, so nothing on the page is cut, and the scrollbar's room stays reserved
A one-axis ScrollArea never scrolls the other way; its content inset keeps edge rings and shadows inside
The outline’s rounded corners crop the table scrolling inside its ScrollArea; cells carry the padding, so rings stay inside
The outline’s rounded corners crop the contexts scrolling inside its ScrollArea; cells carry the padding
The well’s rounded corners crop the code scrolling inside its ScrollArea; the code carries the padding
What a count, dot or presence means, said to assistive technology; the shape shows it
", unread" said to assistive technology; the bold name and dot show it
A description stops after two lines; the full text stays in the accessible name and the DOM
LR59 truncate: a dense results row stays one line, its name and meta ending in an ellipsis; the full words stay in the DOM and the accessible name
A picture is cropped to the round avatar or the square thumbnail; nothing focusable or bordered inside
"Removed …" said to assistive technology; the chip leaving shows it
A long chip name ends with an ellipsis; the full name stays in the text and the Remove button's name
A picture is cropped to the round avatar; nothing focusable or bordered inside
Progress fill (F15.1d, Q38): reveals the fill up to the value from the reading-start edge; nothing inside is focusable, the button keeps its own outline and focus ring
The same progress fill, mirrored for right-to-left text
hideLabel (F15.2b, F15.7; Field since F15.18): the label still names the TextField, NumberField or any Field where a glyph or row heading says what it is
Said to assistive technology only (F15.4): the chosen option is visible in the box

Card (F15.34): crops the full-bleed picture to the card's rounded corners in every layout, stacked or beside; the body's padding keeps the actions' focus rings inside, and the card's own focus ring is its outline, which it never clips
Card: crops the picture to the media frame's shape and corners (plain and row cards round the picture itself); nothing inside is focusable
Carousel (F15.27): crops each slide's picture to its frame; nothing inside is focusable
Carousel: says the slide number after a change, politely; the counter shows it
Carousel: every dot's mark is the pill's size and a resting one is cropped to a circle in its middle, so choosing one never moves anything; the dot's focus ring is on the button, outside the mark
Carousel: crops each thumbnail picture to its button's corners; the button's focus ring is its own outline, drawn inset, which it never clips
Dialog (F15.32): keeps the surface inside its rounded corners; the body is the listed scroll region with its padding inside, and the header's and answers' focus rings sit inside the dialog padding

Sheet (F15.47): keeps the surface inside its rounded corners and stops the slide's overflow; the body is the listed scroll region, and the header's and answers' focus rings sit inside the sheet padding
Lightbox (F15.38): says which picture of how many is shown; the counter shows it

MediaPlayer (F15.49): crops the video, poster or remote frame to the player's rounded corners; the play button sits in the middle, its focus ring well inside, and the native controls draw their own rings inside the video
Persona (F15.26): says the photo was changed or removed; the avatar shows it
Avatar (F15.25): crops the picture or initials to a circle or rounded square; the focus ring, presence and badges sit on the avatar outside the face
Image (F15.36): crops the picture to its frame's shape and corners and holds the space while it loads; nothing inside is focusable
Canvas (Q68): a frame's contents are clipped to the frame, as in a design tool; nothing inside is focusable
Canvas: a text layer is clipped to its own box, as drawn in the document; not focusable
Canvas: a frame's name above it truncates to the frame's width; the layers panel shows it in full
ChatMessage: who said it, read by assistive technology; the bubble's side and style show it
Composer: an attached file's name and kind truncate on one line; its remove button names it in full
ConversationList: a chat's title truncates on one line; the link's focus ring is drawn inside it (inset), so it's never cut
ImageGeneration (Q58): the generating picture and its effect are cropped to the picture's frame; nothing inside is focusable
MessageActions: the outcome of an action (copied, saved), said to assistive technology
TreeView: a long layer name truncates on its row; the row (not the label) takes focus, so its ring is never cut
Switch: a name given for assistive technology only, where the setting's row shows it
Field in compact density: a label truncates beside its field; the field's accessible name is the full label
Slider in compact density: a label truncates beside its track; the slider's accessible name is the full label

AppLayout: the layout holds its height and its regions scroll on their own (ScrollArea); the clip keeps a floating drawer and moving parts inside the layout. Every region's focus ring is drawn inside it

ChatLayout: the layout holds its height and its regions scroll on their own (ScrollArea); the clip keeps a floating drawer and moving parts inside the layout. Every region's focus ring is drawn inside it

EditorLayout: the layout holds its height and its regions scroll on their own (ScrollArea); the clip keeps a floating drawer and moving parts inside the layout. Every region's focus ring is drawn inside it
Motion: a rounded element's view-transition snapshot keeps its corners only while it moves; nothing is clipped at rest
LR122 Breadcrumbs truncate (opt-in): in a narrow header the current page gives way first and ends in an ellipsis; its full name stays in the DOM and the accessible name
LR43: a page's picture is cropped to the mark's small rounded square; the mark isn't focusable, the link's focus ring is on the item around it
hideTitle: the group's title names its list for screen readers without showing
Says where a moved page landed (reorderable group); the list shows it
LR110 showLoading: the shimmer takes the window's shape while the screen loads; it holds no focusable content
A chip group's hidden label names the group for screen readers without showing

scrollRegions.reason: Carousel: the slide track scrolls with snap and carries data-scrollbar="none": its arrows, picker, swipe and keys replace the bar (the one barless region; every other scroll region is a ScrollArea, Q96)
scrollRegions.bar: none: its arrows, picker, swipe and keys replace it
